name: beeper-mcp-addon
description: Files, new chats, catching up, reactions and edits for Beeper's MCP (unofficial companion to Beeper Desktop's MCP)

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add server.json manifest.json
scripts.bundle: rm -rf .bundle && mkdir .bundle && npm run build && cp -r dist manifest.json package.json package-lock.json README.md LICENSE .bundle/ && cd .bundle && npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack . ../beeper-mcp-addon.mcpb

author: juulieen
